messages.text:
Here is where each of your three orders stands.

- **Wicker storage basket:** I can't refund it. Our records show the basket was received back (refund-policy/v2/return). But a refund had to be requested within 30 days of delivery, and that deadline was 2026-11-11 10:00 UTC (refund-policy/v2/window).

- **Linen laundry liner:** Our records don't show it as received back yet. The shop only refunds items it has received back, so it has to arrive first (refund-policy/v2/return). I haven't requested anything for it. Its refund deadline is 2026-12-05 10:00 UTC (refund-policy/v2/window). Your request has to be made by then, and the liner has to be back with us for it to go ahead.

- **Cedar coat hangers:** The order is recorded as delivered, but you say it never arrived. A staff member takes cases like that, so a person will take over this one (refund-policy/v2/eligible-orders).
